description: This file defines the EmailDetail class, which models the full details of an email message, including metadata such as sender, recipients, timestamps, and flags like read or starred. It includes annotations for Swagger documentation and provides getter and setter methods for each field.

classes.name: EmailDetail
classes.description: A data transfer object representing detailed information about an email message, including identifiers, addresses, content, flags, timestamps, and thread information.

methods.name: EmailDetail
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing all fields of EmailDetail.

methods.name: getBodyHtml
methods.description: Returns the email body in HTML format.

methods.name: getBodyText
methods.description: Returns the email body in plain text.

methods.name: isRead
methods.description: Indicates whether the email has been read.

methods.name: isStarred
methods.description: Indicates whether the email is starred.

methods.name: isArchived
methods.description: Indicates whether the email is archived.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the email is deleted.

methods.name: getThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID associated with the email.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email was last updated.

methods.name: getSentAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email was sent.

methods.name: getReceivedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email was received.

methods.name: setBodyHtml
methods.description: Sets the email body in HTML format.

methods.name: setBodyText
methods.description: Sets the email body in plain text.
